arena_coding.title: Array Dedup & Sort
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(arr)` — remove duplicates, return sorted.

arena_coding.title: Palindrome Check
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s)` — return true if palindrome (case-insensitive, alpha only).

testCases.input: "A man a plan a canal Panama"

arena_coding.title: Fibonacci
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(n)` — return nth Fibonacci (0-indexed, F(0)=0, F(1)=1).

arena_coding.title: Max Subarray Sum
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(arr)` — return maximum contiguous subarray sum (Kadane's algorithm).

arena_coding.title: Reverse Words
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s)` — reverse word order in string (trim extra spaces).

arena_coding.title: Two Sum
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums, target)` — return indices of two numbers that add to target.

arena_coding.title: Valid Parentheses
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s)` — return true if brackets ()[]{} are balanced.

arena_coding.title: FizzBuzz Array
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(n)` — return array [1..n] with Fizz/Buzz/FizzBuzz replacements.

arena_coding.title: Binary Search
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(arr, target)` — return index of target in sorted array, or -1.

arena_coding.title: Matrix Transpose
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(matrix)` — return transposed matrix.

arena_coding.title: Count Vowels
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s)` — return count of vowels (aeiouAEIOU).

arena_coding.title: Flatten Array
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(arr)` — flatten nested arrays to single level (arbitrary depth).

arena_coding.title: Roman to Integer
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s)` — convert Roman numeral string to integer.

arena_coding.title: Anagram Check
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(a, b)` — return true if a and b are anagrams (case-insensitive, alpha only).

arena_coding.title: GCD
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(a, b)` — return greatest common divisor.

arena_coding.title: Remove Nth from End
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(arr, n)` — remove nth element from end, return new array.

arena_coding.title: String Compression
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s)` — compress "aabcccccaaa" → "a2b1c5a3".

arena_coding.title: Power of Two
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(n)` — return true if n is a power of 2.

arena_coding.title: Merge Sorted Arrays
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(a, b)` — merge two sorted arrays into one sorted array.

arena_coding.title: Spiral Order
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(matrix)` — return elements in spiral order.

arena_coding.title: Climbing Stairs
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(n)` — you can climb 1 or 2 steps at a time. Return the number of distinct ways to reach step n.

arena_coding.title: Coin Change
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(coins, amount)` — return the fewest number of coins needed to make the amount, or -1 if impossible.

arena_coding.title: Number of Islands
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(grid)` — grid is a 2D array of "1" (land) and "0" (water). Return the number of islands (connected land cells, horizontally or vertically).

arena_coding.title: Longest Substring No Repeat
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s)` — return the length of the longest substring without any repeating characters.

arena_coding.title: Group Anagrams
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(strs)` — group anagrams together. Sort each inner group alphabetically and sort outer array by each group's first element.

arena_coding.title: Decode Ways
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s)` — a string of digits can be decoded using A=1, B=2, ..., Z=26. Return the number of distinct ways to decode the string.

arena_coding.title: Maximum Product Subarray
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — return the maximum product of a contiguous subarray.

arena_coding.title: Longest Palindromic Substring
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s)` — return the longest palindromic substring. If multiple with equal length, return the first occurring.

arena_coding.title: 0-1 Knapsack
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(weights, values, capacity)` — given items with weights and values arrays and a knapsack capacity, return the maximum total value (each item used at most once).

arena_coding.title: Trapping Rain Water
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(height)` — given an elevation map array, compute how much water it can trap after raining.

arena_coding.title: Word Break
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s, wordDict)` — return true if s can be segmented into a space-separated sequence of one or more dictionary words.

arena_coding.title: Course Schedule
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(numCourses, prerequisites)` — prerequisites[i]=[a,b] means take b before a. Return true if you can finish all courses (no cycle).

arena_response_time.question: What is 17 × 23?
What is 13 × 17?
What is 2 to the power of 10?
If you buy 3 items at $4.75 each and pay with a $20 bill, how much change do you get?
What year did the Berlin Wall fall?
A pool fills in 3 hours with pipe A alone and 6 hours with pipe B alone. How many hours to fill it with both pipes open together?
A train travels 240 km in 3 hours. What is its average speed in km/h?
What is the next number in the sequence: 2, 6, 18, 54, ...?
A rectangle has sides of length 12 cm and 5 cm. What is the length of its diagonal?
If 5 machines take 5 minutes to make 5 widgets, how many minutes would 100 machines take to make 100 widgets?
A shirt originally costs $80 and is discounted by 25%. What is the sale price?
What is the sum of all integers from 1 to 100?
How many prime numbers are there between 1 and 20?
All cats are mammals. All mammals are warm-blooded. Are all cats warm-blooded?
What is the speed of light in km/s (approximately)?
A clock shows 3:15. What is the exact angle in degrees between the hour and minute hands?
A farmer has chickens and cows. Together they have 30 heads and 74 legs. How many chickens does the farmer have?
What is the sum of the interior angles of a hexagon in degrees?
A 6-sided die is rolled twice. What is the probability that the sum is exactly 7? Express as a simplified fraction.
If log base 2 of x equals 5, what is x?
A ball is dropped from 100 meters. Each bounce reaches half the previous height. What is the total distance traveled after exactly 3 bounces (including all ups and downs)?

Three people check into a hotel room that costs $30. They each pay $10. The manager gives $5 to the bellboy to return. The bellboy keeps $2 and gives $1 back to each person. Each person paid $9 (total $27) plus $2 the bellboy kept = $29. Where is the missing dollar?
A snail climbs 3 meters up a wall during the day but slides back 2 meters at night. If the wall is 10 meters high, how many days does it take the snail to reach the top?
A car drives 150 km at 60 km/h, then 120 km at 80 km/h. What is the total travel time in hours?
In how many different ways can the letters of the word 'LISTEN' be arranged?
A store sells apples for $0.75 each and oranges for $1.20 each. If someone buys 4 apples and 3 oranges, what is the total cost?
The sides of a right triangle are in the ratio 3:4:5. If the hypotenuse is 20 cm, what is the perimeter?
Two trains start from cities 300 km apart and travel toward each other. Train A travels at 90 km/h and Train B at 60 km/h. After how many hours do they meet?
What is the minimum number of socks you must draw from a drawer containing 3 red socks and 2 blue socks (in the dark) to guarantee a matching pair?
A ladder 10 meters long leans against a vertical wall with its base 6 meters from the wall. How high up the wall does the ladder reach?
What is the remainder when 2 to the power of 100 is divided by 7?
A fair coin is flipped 4 times. What is the probability of getting exactly 2 heads? Express as a simplified fraction.
